string.name: weibo_description
string.value: Browse, like, and comment. Your Cookie stays on this device.

string.name: weibo_privacy_body
string.value: Your login session is stored only on this device after you sign in. Public content can be read without signing in. Likes and comments are sent only when you tap them.

string.name: weibo_software_about_description
string.value: Fluo is a third-party client focused on a fluid, immersive browsing experience.

string.name: weibo_software_about_privacy_description
string.value: Your sign-in session stays only on this device, while public content can be browsed without signing in.
